title: Bisikan di Balik Kubikel
theme: Mengeksplorasi bagaimana kecemasan dan paranoid berlebihan bisa mengubah rutinitas kantor yang sepi menjadi sumber teror konyol.

cover.prompt: Late night office interior, a vast, hushed corporate space. Focus on a corner cubicle where a lone computer monitor emits a faint, cool blue glow, illuminating the immediate workstation. The long corridor beyond is dimly lit with deactivated overhead lamps, creating an expansive, tranquil environment with inactive workstations stretching into the distance. A subtle silhouette of a person is visible at the desk, engaged with the screen. The atmosphere is still and crisp, conveying a profound sense of quiet and coolness. Cinematic composition with rule of thirds, showcasing the breadth of the deserted office.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, cool color palette with subtle light sources

meta.plan_summary: A lone employee working late in a quiet office starts hearing strange sounds, triggering paranoia and wild imaginings about supernatural occurrences or unknown figures. Armed with a stapler, the employee investigates the source, only to find a mundane and humorous explanation: a leaky water dispenser and a hungry cat.
